spec2def(activeds.dll activeds.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(activeds registry activeds.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# activeds.dll is all Rust (activeds-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/activeds-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# activeds_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/activeds-rust/src/activeds/activeds_main.rs)
# pathname.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/activeds-rust/src/activeds/pathname.rs)
# stubs.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/activeds-rust/src/activeds/stubs.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(activeds_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(activeds_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload uuid oldnames libole32 liboleaut32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(activeds_shims)
set(ACTIVEDS_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/activeds/activeds_r.o)
add_cargo_module(activeds activeds-cargo activeds.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE activeds-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS activeds_shims activeds_r ${ACTIVEDS_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
